This week is kicking off with a spooky good EcoFlow Halloween Sale lineup of up to 57% discounts and bonus extra savings, which include deals like the DELTA 3 Ultra Plus 3,072Wh Power Station down at $1,519 , and more starting from $284. We also spotted Monarc Bikes offering new battery configuration packages (up to $579 off) on its Tracer Commuter and Marker All-Terrain Smart e-bikes that now start from $1,399 . There’s also fall savings hitting the EGO Cordless Electric 600 CFM Backpack Leaf Blower at $380 , as well as the 40-mile Hiboy S2 Max Electric Scooter down at $490 , the six-plant AeroGarden Harvest Elite 360 Indoor Hydroponic Garden System down at $85 , and more waiting for you below. You can find all the hangover deals from last week at the bottom of the page, collected together within our latest Electrified Weekly roundup .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker launches new eufy S4 as the ‘world’s first VR doorbell’ with AI tracking
Treat yourself with up to 57% EcoFlow power station savings during its Halloween Sale starting from $284
EcoFlow is offering up to 57% savings treats on power stations with its newly launched Halloween Sale running through the rest of the month , complete with a bonus extra savings code to make the deals all the better. One upper-tier option is the DELTA 3 Ultra Plus 3,072Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,519.05 shipped , after using the code EFPDFAFF at checkout, beating out Amazon by $80 . It carries a $2,199 MSRP, which we’ve seen it spike to a rare amount of times in 2026, with the price more often down at this rate recently. While the price has dipped slightly lower in past months, you’re still getting a total $680 off the MSRP for one of the best prices of the year – just $5 above the price we saw during the Prime Day event from two weeks ago. Head below to check out more of this spooky seasonal lineup of deals.
Popular EcoFlow power stations in 2026:
DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh) power station: $499 (Reg. $749)
DELTA 3 Max (2,048Wh) power station: $899 (Reg. $1,199)
DELTA 3 Ultra Plus (3,072Wh) power station: $1,599 (Reg. $2,199)
DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) power station: $1,799 (Reg. $2,799)
DELTA 3 Ultra Plus (3,072Wh) with 400W solar panel: $1,999 (Reg. $2,699)
DELTA Pro 3 (4,096Wh) power station: $2,799 (Reg. $3,699)
DELTA Pro 3 (4,096Wh) with 400W solar panel: $3,099 (Reg. $3,999)
You can browse EcoFlow’s entire sale lineup in our original roundup of deals here .

New Monarc battery configurations arrive for Tracer and Marker e-bikes starting from $1,399 ($579 off)
Monarch Bikes is offering new battery configurations for its two e-bikes, providing folks with new low prices. These new options begin with the Tracer Urban Commuter Smart e-bike (no battery) at $1,399 shipped , or you can get it with one battery at $1,649 shipped and 2x batteries at $1,899 shipped . Likewise the Marker All-Terrain Smart e-bike (no battery) starts at $1,499 shipped , or get it with one battery at $1,749 shipped and 2x batteries at $1,999 shipped . Up until now, you could only score them with 2x batteries and occasionally additional free gear at $1,899 and $1,999 rates, but these new bundle options provide the best new prices yet, depending on whether you already have batteries or just want a standard one-battery-one-bike package.
You can learn about the Tracer and Marker e-bikes in our original coverage of these new offers here .
EGO’s 600 CFM cordless backpack leaf blower runs for up to 180 minutes of yard clearing down at $380 (Up to $144 off)
Amazon is currently offering the EGO Power+ 56V Cordless Electric 600 CFM Backpack Leaf Blower with 7.5Ah battery down at $379.99 shipped for fall clearing needs. While it’s mostly been keeping at a $479 full price for most of this year, we did see it rise in price in August and has been seen up between $541 and $559 since, with the Prime Day event we saw two weeks ago dipping it lower to $524. Now, the price is finally coming back down at $144 off the recent going rate at Amazon, landing it just $50 above the yearly low that appeared back during June’s Prime Day.
You can learn what this backpack leaf blower brings to your yard clearing here .
Get up to 46 miles of travel on Hiboy’s S2 Max e-scooter and in-app remote locking for $490 right now
Amazon is currently offering commuters with a budget the long-range Hiboy S2 Max Electric Scooter down at $489.96 shipped , beating out the brand’s direct website pricing by $100 . While it may carry an $835 MSRP directly from Hiboy, at Amazon it’s almost entirely kept between $520 and $490, with only occasional spikes as high as $590. Discounts have seen things drop as low as $465 this year though, which was a short-term fall during Prime Day two weeks ago. You’re getting the third-lowest price of the year with this deal, which has it $100 below the highest rate at Amazon and $345 under the MSRP – just $25 above that previous annual low.
Learn all about what this affordable electric scooter adds to your commute here .
Keep six favorite herbs or vegetables within reach with AeroGarden’s Harvest Elite 360 down at $85 ($40 off)
Amazon is offering the AeroGarden Harvest Elite 360 Hydroponic Indoor Garden down at $84.96 shipped right now. It’s dropping down from $125 here, which discounts have mostly kept above $106, though there was one fall lower to $64 in June. You’ll be getting the next-best price of the year with this $40 markdown, which even beats out the previous Prime Day event that had it keeping to its full price.
